timing.label: Objection 1 (technical)
timing.question: How do you know Devin will respect our no-schema-change rule?

timing.label: Objection 2 (commercial)
timing.question: Why pay for an agent to write a plan a senior engineer writes in ten minutes?

problem.quote: there are a lot of problems. Actually, the oversell one is bad, the rounding one is bad, and the leak is a security thing

evidence.quote: I will know it worked when npm test is green and the report balances

next_step.quote: The next step is to start the session

tag_question_examples: a schema change for the inventory lock, no?

must_mention.point: Both brands run on a single shared codebase and database
The cost of the chosen problem stated in orders, money or engineer-days
must_mention.evidence_quote: maybe forty orders, and the rounding is a few cents on three percent of orders

must_mention.point: One Devin capability for the first session with one reason it beats an alternative
The proof of success described as an observable artefact rather than a command
One thing the plan refuses to do because of the schema freeze, main or budget

article_plural_slips: "a few hundred maybe" — give the number from the brief
sentences_to_rerecord: So, basically, there are a lot of problems.
And I will know it worked when npm test is green and the report balances, isn't it?

accuracy.anchor: Only the cost was stated; no single problem, no capability, evidence given as commands, no refused action (anchor: 0–8 = one point or fewer).

structure.anchor: Approach missing; three problems chosen at once; the update skipped Outcome and Ask (anchor: 6–10 = two or more parts missing or order lost).

customer_relevance.anchor: Numbers partly recalled ("a few hundred maybe"); the schema freeze was contradicted by proposing a schema change (anchor: 6–9 = brief misread on a constraint).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Framing 52 s over, three segments well under; 12 fillers in 5.8 minutes, two tag questions, a 12-second pause (anchor: 4–6 = most segments off target, fillers over 2/min).

recovery.anchor: Neither objection followed the pattern; no evidence offered; the "how many orders" interruption was not recovered from (anchor: 3–5 = acknowledged only).

stems: "The first task is X — one task, one session." — choose before you speak.
"I will use <capability> because…" — name the Devin capability, not "ask Devin to look at all of it".
"You would see…" — replace every command with an observation.
previous_run_comparison: First recorded run for dryrun on lab 00; no previous run to compare with.
